text:
We checked “3 err 2 warn transformation” and found 4 issues in the InDesign file that are likely causing the problems in Frontify, plus 2 that may change how it looks. Here’s what to change:

Likely causing the problems

1. Item is flipped or skewed
Frontify can’t reproduce flipped or skewed items, so they’ll look different or break when edited.
Where: images “230209_FRO2301_NYC_15.jpg” (page 2) and “Frontify_Linkedin-Cover-Employee_1584x396.png” (page 2)
• Images: Double-click to select the image inside the frame, then choose Object > Transform > Clear Transformations (or set the shear angle to 0° and remove the flip).
• If you need the flipped look, save a flipped copy of the image file instead.
• Image frames: Select the image frame and choose Object > Transform > Clear Transformations (or set the shear angle to 0° and remove the flip).
Learn more

2. Text without a paragraph style
Frontify uses paragraph styles to format text and decide what can be edited.
Where: text frames “Image in frame rotation and fram…” (page 1), “in frame flip vertical image onl…” (page 2)
• Select the text (or the whole frame) and apply a paragraph style in Window > Styles > Paragraph Styles (any style except [Basic Paragraph] or [No Paragraph Style]).
Learn more

3. Embedded image
Frontify needs images as separate linked files and can’t read images embedded in the document.
Where: the image “Desktop-background_patterns.png” (page 2)
• In Window > Links, select the image and choose Unembed Link from the panel menu.
• Save it into the Links folder and package again.
Learn more

4. Linked image missing from the package
The document links to an image that isn’t in the package, so Frontify can’t show it.
Where: the image “logo_FÃ¶rderturm_original.png” (page 1)
• Relink any missing images in Window > Links.
• Package again with File > Package with "Copy Linked Graphics" checked.
Learn more

May change how it looks

5. Paragraph Composer used
The Adobe Paragraph Composer breaks lines differently from browsers, so text may reflow in Frontify.
Where: the paragraph style “[Basic Paragraph]”, used on page 1
• In the paragraph style, go to Justification and set Composer to Adobe Single-line Composer.
Learn more

6. Unused images in the package
These files aren’t used in the document and only make the package bigger.
Where: the image “logo_Förderturm_original.png”
• Delete the unused files from the Links folder before zipping the package.
Learn more

Once that’s done, package the document again with File > Package, zip the package folder and upload it to Frontify.
